exact: envenomation resulting in pore formation in membrane of another organism
envenomation resulting in pore formation in membrane of other organism

definition: A process that begins with venom being forced into an organism by the bite or sting of another organism, and ends with the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a pore complex in a membrane of the bitten organism.
label: venom-mediated pore formation in membrane of another organism
